instruction: A sleek pistol-grip scanning device projecting a shimmering translucent data fan above its emitter. The chassis surface flickers with iridescent rainbow sheen that shifts between magenta, cyan, and gold as it turns. Glowing indicator dots and a floating semi-transparent readout give it a futuristic, light-woven appearance while remaining a single centered gadget.
